column1: # GameApplication/DesktopApplication: the abstract hooks and their only implementation.
#   e() returns !SystemHook.isTabletMode() -> isDesktopMode (the UI needs to know it is not a slate).
#   f()/g() build the DefaultAddressProvider / DesktopPortMapper -> getAddressProvider /
#   getPortMappingCallback. a(String) opens the URI through java.awt.Desktop -> openUrl.
#   h() forwards to DesktopLauncher.resetCursor() -> resetCursor ; i() loads data/shared/cursor.gif
#   and applies it -> setCustomCursor. a(int,int)/b(int,int) pull the mouse back from the window
#   edge (12px margin, using Mouse.getEventDX/DY) -> clampMouseX / clampMouseY.
#   c(int,int) is the resize path called from render(): it rescales to 800px minimum, rebuilds the
#   downscale framebuffer/shader/buffers and forwards to screen.resize -> onResize.
# DesktopLauncher: the static a is the shutdown flag the main loop waits on
#   a() is the empty "restore the default cursor" hook -> resetCursor ; a(PlatformCursor) applies a
#   cursor via Mouse.setNativeCursor -> applyCursor ; b(PlatformCursor) is the private worker behind
#   it -> applyNativeCursor ; a(int,int,Pixmap) is the public single-image entry point
#   -> createCursor ; b(int,int,Pixmap) is its private worker -> buildCursor ;
#   a(int,int,Pixmap[],int[]) builds an animated cursor (frame delays array) -> createAnimatedCursor.
# SystemHook: a() reads GetSystemMetrics(8195) = SM_CONVERTIBLESLATEMODE -> isTabletMode ;
#   b() lazily loads user32 through JNA -> getUser32 ; c()/d() detect Windows 8 or later
# UPnPMapper: the three static a(...) overloads map a port (TCP, or with an explicit protocol) and
#   return the external IP -> mapPort ; a(String) removes a mapping by name -> unmapPort ; the
#   private a(InternetGatewayDevice,int,PortProtocol) deletes it on the device -> deleteMapping ;
#   the private a() finds the first gateway -> discoverGateway.
